summary: Frontend E2E validation of Althea EVOLUTION ENGINE AEE/2.0. All required flows work: backend smoke GETs (/api/evolution/version reports protocol AEE/2.0; /assessment returns 8 vectors with probabilities summing to ~1.0); Evolution tab renders header, stats (evolution-version V1.99.1, cycle-count, verified-count>0), full 8-row vector-board with vector-row-<VECTOR> data-testids and favored=AUTONOMY; force MEMORY + evolution-tick-btn produced banner '[SELF-UPGRADE #b938dca9] target MEMORY -> semantic_compression - 5/5 checks - v1.101.1', cycle count incremented, new verified cycle card appeared at top of upgrade timeline with MEMORY badge and green check chips; evolution-run-<id> button ran module and evolution-run-output-<id> pre showed 'self-test PASSED - 3ms' plus JSON payload; clicking master-DIJKSTRA archetype spawned a new cycle referencing DIJKSTRA lens and returned another SELF-UPGRADE banner (5/5). Terminal commands worked: /vectors printed '[SELF-ASSESSMENT AEE/2.0] favored: ...' and 8 vector lines; /evolve AUTONOMY produced a VERIFIED self-upgrade line with 'target: AUTONOMY' and 'module: direct_cognition_v2' and switched center deck to evolution tab; /cycles listed cycles with vector names. Zero-LLM chat verified end-to-end (screenshot confirms): 'what is 45 * 12?' -> '[DIRECT COGNITION v2 - zero-LLM - local pattern: calculation - confidence 0.99]  45 * 12 = 540' with DIRECT/ZERO-LLM/EVO-V2 tags; 'convert 5 km to miles' -> '5 km = 3.10685 mi'; 'what comes next: 3, 6, 12, 24' -> 'next ~= 48 [geometric (x2)]'. Worker mesh EVOLUTION core shows specialty 'self-directed growth' with last task 'SELF-UPGRADED #... RESILIENCE -> fallback_cascade - 4/4 checks' (regression clean).

issues: Non-blocking React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> in EvolutionScreen.jsx line ~94 (v-editor injects a wrapping span into option). Not user-visible but produces a console error on hydration. Consider marking option contents as excluded or plain text.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Strip Vercel/v-editor span injection inside <option> in EvolutionScreen.jsx to silence hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: EvolutionScreen renders due to editor instrumentation - triggers React hydration warning; harmless functionally but pollutes console.

Cycle count / verified count auto-increment every ~30s from backend worker as designed; consider visual pulse indicator when self-triggered cycle lands to differentiate from manual ticks (nice-to-have).

Autonomous background cycles + manual ticks share the same evolution-last-result banner; if a background cycle fires between user click and UI update, the banner may reflect autonomous cycle rather than user-forced one (observed target still matched MEMORY here, but timing could race).
seed_data_creation: None. Created ~6 evolution cycles via tick / archetype / /evolve during testing (well below limit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All EVO-V2 flows validated on prod URL. Do NOT DELETE /api/evolution/cycles. Zero-LLM chat path is confirmed via terminal - reply banner has ALTHEA + DIRECT + ZERO-LLM + EVO-V2 tags. When scraping terminal text via evaluate innerText from document.body the terminal content is at TOP-LEFT of layout, not bottom; use data-testid='terminal-log' or scoped selector to grep responses, otherwise assertions will match sidebar mesh log instead.
